_comment: Reference VM shape, for booting one VM by hand while debugging (no jailer, as root):
ip tuntap add dev fctap1 mode tap && ip addr add 172.30.0.5/30 dev fctap1 && ip link set fctap1 up
The manager configures VMs through the API socket instead; keep these values in sync with

boot-source.boot_args: console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=1 pci=off random.trust_cpu=on net.ifnames=0 ip=172.30.0.6::172.30.0.5:255.255.255.252::eth0:off systemd.hostname=shellhouse-debug shellhouse.vnc_password=debugpw1 shellhouse.sudo=0
